name: Locksmith

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Marco and Lena (locksmiths at the counter)

services.name: Lock rekey
services.story: The main story: a $35 rekey of two locks Alex brings in. Nothing is taken: a YES books it. Alex pays at the counter.

services.name: Car key copy
services.story: A $40 car key copy. A card is saved for the shop's $20 fee for a missed bench time. Alex pays at the counter.

services.name: Master key set
services.story: The $140 master key set (2½ hours). A $40 deposit pays for the key blanks. The $100 rest is paid at the counter.

services.name: High-security key copy
services.story: A $55 high-security key copy, paid in full when booking, since the blank is ordered for Alex.

services.name: Antique lock repair
services.story: An antique lock repair: Alex sends photos, Marco prices it at $90, and it's booked once it's OK'd.

services.name: Lock repair
services.story: A lock repair at the bench: only the $25 bench check is promised, and Marco prices the repair when he sees the lock.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Tomás and Andre (locksmiths; one is on call each night)

services.name: Whole-home rekey
services.story: The main story: a $179 whole-home rekey. A card is saved for the $89 trip fee. Rosie texts the bill after the job. A lockout at night runs the same way: $199, with a card saved for the $89 fee.

services.name: Whole-home rekey
services.story: A $179 whole-home rekey. A card is saved and charged $179 when Tomás texts DONE.

services.name: Whole-home rekey
services.story: A property manager's rekey: a card is saved for the $89 trip fee, and Sam bills the manager the business's own way.

services.name: Smart lock install
services.story: A $150 smart lock install, paid in full when booking.

services.name: High-security locks
services.story: High-security locks priced from photos at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it). A $160 deposit now; the rest on the bill after the job.

services.name: Lock repair
services.story: A lock repair priced at the visit. Only the $89 trip fee is promised, and a card is saved for it.

questions_before_times: Is anyone locked inside, like a child, a pet or an at-risk adult, or in danger? (Yes: 911 first, no booking)
What kind of lock: regular, smart, high-security, or don't know?
Do you own or rent? Is your name on the deed, lease or registration?
Does anyone object to you going in, like an ex, a roommate or a landlord?
Do you have a photo ID with you?
safety_stop: a child, a pet or an at-risk adult locked inside a car or a home
a car running in a closed garage
someone who objects to the entry: an ex, a roommate or a landlord
license: Where the state's rules require it: a locksmith license for the business, and one for each locksmith sent out. Where none is required: identity checked, and 'license: what the business says'.
staff_skills: ["Lockouts: home and car","Rekeys and lock changes","High-security and smart locks","Car keys","Antique locks (the shop)","Alarm work: only people with the alarm license"]
